meta.name: instagram-hashtag-posts
meta.description: Scrapes Instagram posts by hashtag, returning media items with captions, like/comment counts, media URLs and user info from the hashtag explore feed. Use when user mentions Instagram hashtag scraping, get posts by hashtag, IG hashtag feed, scrape Instagram by tag, hashtag posts Instagram, search Instagram hashtag, pull posts from hashtag, Instagram topic posts, trending hashtag content, Instagram tag posts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按话题标签抓取 Instagram 帖子数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取 Instagram 话题标签下的帖子内容
copy.tagline_en: Scrape Instagram posts by hashtag for media and engagement data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collect Instagram posts by hashtag for analysis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动抓取指定 Instagram 话题标签下的帖子，返回每条帖子的图片/视频链接、文字描述、点赞数、评论数和发布者用户名。
howto.when: 当你提到“Instagram 话题标签”、“按标签获取帖子”、“IG 标签内容”等关键词，或要求搜索 Instagram 话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我抓取 #travel 话题的最新帖子。
搜索 #photography 标签，显示前 10 条帖子。
say.note: Claude 会获取该标签的帖子并展示结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically scrape Instagram posts for a given hashtag, returning media URLs, captions, like/comment counts, and usernames.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'Instagram hashtag', 'get posts by hashtag', 'IG tag feed', or similar keywords related to Instagram hashtag scraping.

say_en.note: Claude will open Instagram and return posts for that hashtag.
Claude will retrieve posts for that tag and display results.
